card.name: Linux man page headers and errors
card.fires_on: Words inside Linux manual pages for tmpfile and mailaddr, mainly the NAME line after the command name and the short error descriptions in the ERRORS section.

modes.label: NAME line
modes.description: The dash or the command name part in the NAME header of a man page.
modes.example: NAME tmpfile<< ->> create a temporary file SYNOPSIS #include

modes.label: Error descriptions
modes.description: Words in short error explanations after error codes like EINTR or ENFILE.
modes.example: EINTR<< The>> call was interrupted by a signal.

card.plain: It lights up on words in Linux programmer manual pages, such as the title line and the error list.
